text:
aj: Quick question — onboarding ACME Private (VPC) today. Where should their OTLP/exporter point for traces/metrics? Also who sets up Prom remote_write -> our ingest or their Grafana? Trying to run preflight checklist before handoff :slightly_smiling_face:
observability-bot: Created onboarding checklist /onboard/acme-vpc (ticket #ACME-3421) — assigned to eng-platform. Reminder: attach TLS certs and add peering info.
lina: For metrics/traces OTLP: point them at otlp-collector.acme.vpc.redwood:4317 (TLS required). We’ll provide a signed client cert for mTLS. For Prom remote_write we prefer them sending to our push endpoint (metrics-push.prod.redwood:9091) so we can apply tenant isolation & dedup.
devon: Grafana: we provision a read-only Grafana in their VPC that proxies to their Prom so dashboards are local and queries are fast. Example dashboard (internal): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/acme/tenant-overview — use that as the starting template.
sahil: A few alert notes: lower sensitivity for customer-hosted Prom (increase aggregation window to 5m for latency alerts), add suppressions for scheduled backups and deploy windows. I’ll publish a recommended alert bundle.
aj: Thanks. Two quick config asks: (1) short remote_write snippet we can paste into their Prom config? (2) do we need an explicit ingress/peering rule for 4317 from their subnet? :eyes:
lina: ```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: "https://metrics-push.prod.redwood:9091/api/v1/push"
    basic_auth:
      username: "acme-remote"
      password: "<redacted>"
    tls_config:
      insecure_skip_verify: false
      ca_file: "/etc/prom/certs/ca.pem"
      cert_file: "/etc/prom/certs/client.pem"
      key_file: "/etc/prom/certs/client-key.pem"
    write_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: "node_.*"
        action: keep
```
Note: we require TLS client certs; we also accept OTLP for traces on 4317.
devon: Yes to the peering/ingress rule — open TLS port 4317 from their egress CIDR to the collector IP. We’ll coordinate a VPC peering / transit route with infra. @sahil can you add the alert tuning PR?
sahil: On it — I’ll drop a PR with alert thresholds + a suppression template. Also for logs: we prefer OTLP logs where possible; otherwise instruct them to forward JSON stdout to our log-shipper endpoint (lumberjack-style). I’ll add small parsers for common ACME app fields.
aj: Perfect — I’ll run the preflight checklist and attach certs + peering info to #ACME-3421. Ping me if anyone needs anything else. :thumbsup:
observability-bot: Added comment to #ACME-3421 with Lina's cert instructions and Devon's Grafana link.
aj: Thanks all, closing the loop for now.
